notes: Registry rows: the tracked feeds that existed when the public page's snapshot was generated (2026-09-30).

Coverage counts (row_count, last_ingested, latest_data): the production coverage table as it stood on 2026-10-21. Production keeps no history of this table, so the 2026-09-30 counts behind the page cannot be recovered.
layers.mf_projects: every active multifamily/townhome permit-layer project on 2026-10-21 (id, metro, product, stage, units only).

layers.pipeline_unified, layers.sfd_projects, layers.entitlement_other: the candidate rows the per-metro project sample is drawn from on 2026-10-21. Three rows were dropped by hand (a name matching the repo's scrub denylist and two that read as a person's residence).
Example-feed tables: ten public-record rows each, with contact fields removed and the Nashville planning captions' requested-by clause redacted.
